sloka: तेषां संवदतामेवं श्रोतऽणां हर्षवर्धनम् ।गेयं प्रचक्रतुस्तत्र तावुभौ मुनिदारकौ ।। ७.९४.१४ ॥
transliteration: teṣāṁ saṁvadatāmevaṁ śrota'ṇāṁ harṣavardhanam ।geyaṁ pracakratustatra tāvubhau munidārakau ।। 7.94.14 ॥

translations.english: While they were conversing thus, those two sons of the sage performed the song there, which increased the joy of the listeners.
